newsitem.title: USA: Oglethorpe Power Corp may refund $143 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Oglethorpe Power Corp may refund $143 mln in debt.

text.p: Oglethorpe Power Corp on Tuesday said it may refund $143.2 million of OPC Scherer Funding Corp 9.70 percent serial facility bonds due June 30, 2011.
Pending market conditions, a new issue of serial facility bonds will likely be issued in October, the company said.

The 9.70 percent bonds were originally issued in 1986 in connection with a leveraged lease of Oglethorpe Power's 60 percent undivided ownership interest in Unit 2 of the Robert W. Scherer coal-fired generating facility.

Oglethorpe Power supplies wholesale electric power to 39 of Georgia's 42 retail Electric Membership Corporations (EMCs). These EMCs serve more than 2.6 million Georgians in about two-thirds of the state's land area.
